ir_gluco_ir.name: Gluco IR
ir_gluco_ir.key: Per 5 capsules: 100 mg dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage), 300 mg alpha-lipoic acid, 600 mcg chromium, 2,000 mcg biotin, 500 mg Ceylon cinnamon, 200 mg gymnema, plus fenugreek, nettle, bitter melon, green tea and banaba
ir_gluco_ir.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Gluco IR SS ND506 Rev. 11/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Gluco IR SS ND506.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA2Chg, read 2026-11-03). Supplement Facts, serving size 5 capsules, 30 servings: biotin 2,000 mcg (6,667% DV), chromium (as chromium picolinate) 600 mcg (1,714% DV), Ceylon cinnamon powder 500 mg, stinging nettle powder 500 mg, fenugreek extract 500 mg, alpha lipoic acid 300 mg, bitter melon extract 250 mg, green tea extract 200 mg, Gymnema sylvestre extract 200 mg, dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) 100 mg, banaba extract 50 mg. Directions: 'Take five capsules daily'. Claims used on the card: 'Promotes healthy blood glucose levels already in the normal range'; chromium 'helps support the action of insulin'. The same amounts for nine of the eleven ingredients are in the product DB (scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json R960, catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the switch charts). Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 'R960 150C'. URL: repo blasts/2026-09-22-gluco-ir-back.html. 'With meals' and the 3 + 2 split: Asher's blood-sugar patient handout (repo handouts/blood-sugar-patient-handout.pdf: 'Take your Gluco IR with a meal inside your eating window, five capsules a day or as your provider directs'). Sheet-local key: the shared gluco_ir line used by other sheets is unchanged.

ir_berberine.name: Berberine Pro
ir_berberine.key: Per capsule: 100 mg dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) + 84 mg organic Ceylon cinnamon bark extract
ir_berberine.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Berberine Pro SS ND1130 Rev. 11/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Berberine Pro SS ND1130.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA3OYw, read 2026-11-03). Supplement Facts, serving size 1 capsule, 90 servings: dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) 100 mg, organic cinnamon extract (bark; Cinnamomum ceylon) 84 mg. Directions: 'Take one capsule three times daily before meals'. Claims used on the card: 'Promotes healthy glucose metabolism'; 'Supports heart health & optimal lipid balance'. Same facts in the product DB (R2125). Kenneth Johnson GLC 2026 protocol (Dropbox id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA7hTA, via scratchpad wf/protocol-insulin-resistance.json): 'Berberine Pro: 1 cap TID wf'; the sheet prints the label timing (before meals). The rhythm keeps three separate doses; the breakfast and lunch doses share the Morning box because the shared rhythm has no midday slot. No verified product-page slug, so the link falls back to the nutridyn.com catalog search.

ir_ala.name: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
ir_ala.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Alpha Lipoic Acid SS ND283 Rev. 8/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Alpha Lipoic Acid SS ND283.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAuCuA, read 2026-11-03; same panel in scratchpad labels/labels.json R270). Supplement Facts: serving size 1 capsule, 100 servings, alpha-lipoic acid 200 mg. Directions: 'Adults take one capsule daily'. Claims used on the card: 'Supports healthy blood sugar balance'; 'supporting antioxidant activity in the body and energy production from carbohydrates'. Timing: the same sell sheet says 'supplementation prior to consuming a carbohydrate-based meal may support healthy blood glucose levels', so the one daily capsule goes before breakfast. Kenneth Johnson GLC 2026 protocol writes 'Alpha-Lipoic Acid 200 mg: 1 cap TID'; the sheet prints the label dose and leaves a higher dose to the practitioner. Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 'Alpha-Lipoic Acid R270 100C'. Photo: only the 160 px chart thumbnail (scratchpad products/img/R270.png) is staged; Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R270R.png (id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA5I7g) and R270_Web (id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA5JCA) are the print candidates. No verified product-page slug, so the link falls back to the nutridyn.com catalog search.

ir_omega.name: Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000
ir_omega.key: Per softgel: 1,000 mg EPA + DHA (730 mg EPA, 270 mg DHA), 1.1 g total omega-3
ir_omega.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416 Rev. 4/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAyHow, read 2026-11-03). Supplement Facts, serving size 1 softgel, 120 servings: total omega-3 fatty acids 1.1 g, EPA 730 mg, DHA 270 mg, additional omega-3 100 mg; contains fish (anchovy, sardine, mackerel). Directions: 'Take one softgel 1-3 times daily with food'; the same sheet: EPA + DHA of 1,000-3,000 mg a day 'comes out to 1-2 servings of Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 daily'. Claim used on the card: 'Healthy cardiovascular function'. Same amounts in the product DB (R243). Kenneth Johnson GLC 2026 protocol: 'Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000: 2 softgels BID wf where triglycerides are raised' (4 a day, above the label's 3); the sheet prints 2 a day with food, inside the label. URL slug from products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc).
